categories.title: Layout
categories.intro: Boxes and grids that hold everything else. Start every dashboard with a Grid of Cards.

samples.title: Card
samples.description: The Fiori container. Header on top, any control inside <f:content>.

samples.title: Responsive grid
samples.description: 12-column grid. Each child gets a span per screen size (XL/L/M/S).

samples.title: Tabs
samples.description: Split a busy dashboard into views. Counts come from expression binding.

samples.title: Story header
samples.description: Tell the viewer what question this dashboard answers.

categories.title: KPIs
categories.intro: The 3-second answer. Big number, unit, target and a colour that says good or bad.

samples.title: KPI card (single)
samples.description: Numeric header card bound to ONE KPI with binding="{/kpis/0}".

samples.title: KPI card row (all)
samples.description: Same card, repeated for every KPI by binding the grid content to /kpis.

samples.title: KPI tiles
samples.description: Launchpad tiles with a coloured number and trend arrow.

samples.title: Tiles with sparkline
samples.description: Each KPI with its last 6 months as a mini line chart.

categories.title: Charts
categories.intro: Full-size charts (sap.viz). Dimensions = the labels, measures = the numbers, feeds = which goes on which axis.

samples.title: Line: actual vs. plan
samples.description: Best for a trend over time.

samples.title: Column: this year vs. last year
samples.description: Compare two series month by month.

samples.title: Combination: columns + line
samples.description: Actual as bars, plan as a line on top.

samples.title: Bar: value vs. target
samples.description: Compare categories (plants, regions). Long labels fit better horizontally.

samples.title: Bullet: actual vs. target marker
samples.description: One bar per category with its target as a marker.

samples.title: Donut: share of total
samples.description: Parts of a whole. Use with 6 slices or fewer.

categories.title: Micro charts
categories.intro: Tiny charts that fit in a tile, a list row or a table cell.

samples.title: Radial
samples.description: A single percentage as a ring.

samples.title: Bullet in a list
samples.description: Actual vs. target for every KPI.

samples.title: Comparison
samples.description: A compact ranking of categories.

samples.title: Stacked bar
samples.description: How a total is split, in one line.

samples.title: Column trend
samples.description: 12 months in a small space. Colour computed with expression binding (actual >= plan).

categories.title: Tables & lists
categories.intro: The details behind the numbers. Use highlight and ObjectStatus so problems jump out.

samples.title: Responsive table
samples.description: Row highlight, progress bar, status and formatted money. Columns pop in on small screens.

samples.title: Object list
samples.description: A compact list for a narrow column.

samples.title: Table with micro chart
samples.description: A chart inside every row.

categories.title: Status & alerts
categories.intro: Tell the user what needs action. Fiori colours: Success (green), Warning (orange), Error (red), Information (blue).

samples.title: Message strips
samples.description: Banners for alerts.

samples.title: Notification list
samples.description: An inbox of things to look at, with priority.

samples.title: Status building blocks
samples.description: ObjectStatus, ObjectNumber and GenericTag.

samples.title: Progress bars
samples.description: Completion per record.

categories.title: Filters
categories.intro: Let the user slice the data. These are UI only: wire the events to your own controller code if you have time.

samples.title: Filter row
samples.description: Date range, multi-select and a segmented button.

samples.title: Toolbar with search
samples.description: Put it on top of a table or card.

categories.title: Page templates
categories.intro: Whole dashboards. Paste one into the slot in Dashboard.view.xml, then make it yours.

samples.title: Overview
samples.description: KPI row, trend + share charts, detail table. The classic.

samples.title: Analytical list
samples.description: Filters, one big chart, detail table. For exploring a single measure.

samples.title: Exception cockpit
samples.description: Alerts first, then KPIs against target. For people who must act today.
